{{Top|leg}}
'''Kueget LN-21 blaster pistols''' were weapons used by [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] security personnel. The [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistols]] were sleek, and could fire blaster bolts as well as stun bolts and blasts. In order to prevent the weapons from falling into the wrong hands, they were equipped with various safety mechanisms, such as key locks. [[Transponder]]s were also installed in each pistol so that the authorities could track each gun.<ref name="CSWE Kueget">{{CSWECite|2|235|Kueget LN-21 blaster pistol}}</ref>
